'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The [[Russia]]n-installed head of [[Liubymivka, Kakhovka Raion, Kherson Oblast|Liubymivka, Kakhovka Raion]], Andrei Shlepa, is [[assassinate]]d in a [[car bomb]]ing in the [[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast|Russian-occupied]] part of the [[Kherson Oblast|Kherson region]]. Russia accuses [[Ukraine]] of being behind the attack. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/official-in-russian-controlled-ukraine-region-killed-in-car-bomb-attack (Reuters via ''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Somalia]]'s ministry of defense says that the [[Somali Armed Forces|military]] has recaptured the key town of [[Runirgod District|Runirgod]] from [[al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]]. 150 [[insurgent]]s were killed and 15 others were arrested in the [[military operation|operation]]. [https://english.news.cn/20221223/f513da37e66a4a02b6a4025bfacd3912/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*One person is killed and 20 others are injured when a bus overturns in [[Pallai]], [[Northern Province, Sri Lanka|Northern Province]], [[Sri Lanka]]. [http://www.colombopage.com/archive_22B/Dec22_1671692289CH.php (ColomboPage)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Fijian general election#Aftermath and reactions|Aftermath of the 2022 Fijian general election]]
**[[Fiji]] mobilises its [[military of Fiji|army]] in response to threats made against the country's [[minority groups]] and ongoing [[civil unrest]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/481289/fiji-mobilises-army-after-threats-to-minority-groups (RNZ)]
*[[LGBT rights in Scotland]]
**The [[Scottish Parliament]] passes the [[Gender Recognition Reform (Scotland) Bill]] by 86–39 votes, amending the [[Gender Recognition Act 2004]] of the [[Parliament of the United Kingdom]] to simplify the [[Legal status of transgender people|legal gender change]] process in [[Scotland]]. The bill now awaits [[royal assent]]. [https://mb.com.ph/2022/12/23/scotland-passes-law-easing-gender-change-rules/ (AFP via ''Manila Bulletin'')]
*[[LGBT rights in Spain]]
**The [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Congress of Deputies]] passes a bill by 188–150 votes allowing anyone over the age of 16 to legally change their [[gender]] on their [[Documento Nacional de Identidad (Spain)|national identity card]]. The bill will now head to the [[Senate of Spain|Senate]] for final approval. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-64069974 (BBC News)]
*[[Bankruptcy of FTX]]
**The [[United States District Court for the Southern District of New York]] releases [[FTX (company)|FTX]] co-founder and former [[chief executive officer]] [[Sam Bankman-Fried]] on a [[United States dollar|$]]250 million [[bail]] on the condition that he resides at his parents' home in [[Palo Alto, California]], while he awaits trial on [[Fraud#Criminal fraud|criminal fraud]] charges over the [[Chapter 11, Title 11, United States Code|bankruptcy]] of his [[cryptocurrency exchange]]. [https://www.deccanherald.com/international/world-news-politics/us-judge-orders-release-of-ftx-boss-bankman-fried-on-250-mn-bail-1174243.html (AFP via ''Deccan Herald'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Aftermath of the [[2022 Slovenian presidential election]]
**[[Nataša Pirc Musar]] is sworn in as the first female [[President of Slovenia]]. [https://sloveniatimes.com/natasa-pirc-musar-sworn-in-as-slovenias-fifth-president/ (''Slovenia Times'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[Coventry City F.C.]] receive a suspended five-point deduction after postponing three home games following the conclusion of the [[2022 Commonwealth Games|Commonwealth Games]] in August. The team will need to pay compensation to the three opponents as well as to the [[English Football League|EFL]]. Coventry's chief executive blamed debt-ridden [[rugby union]] club [[Wasps RFC]], who also use [[Coventry Building Society Arena|the stadium]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2022/dec/22/coventry-handed-suspended-five-point-deduction-over-postponed-games (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Rugby union in Italy|Italian rugby union]] team [[Benetton Rugby|Benetton Treviso]] suspends an unnamed player following an investigation by the Italian [[public prosecutor's office]] on [[Racism in Italy|racist]] behavior exhibited during a [[Secret Santa]] team event involving [[Guinea]]-born player [[Cherif Traorè]], in which the suspended player reportedly [[Christmas gift|gifted]] Traorè a rotten banana. [https://www.news.com.au/sport/rugby/italian-rugby-club-treviso-suspends-player-over-racist-secret-santa-present/news-story/8fd4e10763794a01b1b988d3b856911a (AFP via news.com.au)]
